limits: Full-model failure in the actual React outer preview was not exercised.
WebGL context loss and manifest fatal-error propagation were not exercised.

Source inspection: fatal() does not post an error to the React parent, so an initial manifest/WebGL fatal error leaves the outer loading overlay until its 45-second timeout. After first model success, context loss is handled by the inner fatal panel and reload button.
